verdict.rationale: The reviewer concern is valid. The story asks for a sandbox or test environment that keeps production data separate. That axis fits a hosted service or API that holds production data; mise is a local tool, environment and task manager with no production data or API of its own (no OpenAPI found, mise-probe-3). The nearby features do not show mise shipping this capability, so they earn no credit and do not make the axis applicable. These include config overlays for dev, test and production, an off-by-default sandbox that limits what a task can access, `--dry-run` previews, and the MCP server.
